system.boundary: Build a Simscape Multibody model of a six-wheel planetary rover that follows a supplied three-dimensional path over a supplied terrain, retrieves a sample with an onboard manipulator, and places it in onboard storage.
engineering_objects: The rover must use a physically connected six-wheel rocker-bogie suspension with six distinct wheel-terrain contacts.
Regulate rover speed and path tracking in closed loop through physical drive and steering actuation.
Include a physically articulated six-joint manipulator that performs sample pickup and storage.
physical_paths: The rover must use a physically connected six-wheel rocker-bogie suspension with six distinct wheel-terrain contacts.
Regulate rover speed and path tracking in closed loop through physical drive and steering actuation.
Use six electric drive motors and four electric steering motors connected through their mechanical transmission paths.
Include a physically articulated six-joint manipulator that performs sample pickup and storage.
functional_paths: Regulate rover speed and path tracking in closed loop through physical drive and steering actuation.
Use six electric drive motors and four electric steering motors connected through their mechanical transmission paths.
Controller and trajectory-generation methods are unrestricted.
